_comment: brain() routing. Each tier lists CLIs in preference order; the router tries them in turn, skipping disabled/rate-limited ones. Spreads load to respect each subscription's fair-use. Edit freely — no restart needed (read per call).

gemini._disabled_why: PERMANENT (2026-07-26): Google discontinued Gemini Code Assist for individual accounts — sign-in returns "This client is no longer supported... migrate to the Antigravity suite". This is NOT a login problem; do not retry re-auth. To use Gemini in brain(), add a free Google AI Studio API key (GEMINI_API_KEY) and write a direct HTTP adapter — the CLI path is dead. Claude + codex both work and are both vision-capable, so the engine needs nothing from Google.

codex._timeout_why: 300s covered vision review of 10 frames (audit lens c timed out at 180s). Raised to 480s on 2026-08-17: the creative script stage writes six full reels against a ~35k-char brief and now needs 300-400s, so codex was timing out at exactly 300s on EVERY script stage — run 2026-08-17-mswozohk burned ~30 minutes of wall clock failing the whole tier twice and surviving only on the tier-'code' retry. Kept below creative.ts STAGE_DEADLINE_MS so claude(300s)+codex(480s) still fits inside one stage.

claude._timeout_why: Raised 300s -> 480s on 2026-09-06: the creative script stage writes six full reels against a ~35k-char brief and claude timed out at exactly 300000ms on the first scheduled run (0 variants). Same reason codex was raised to 480s on 2026-08-17. Both must stay below creative.ts STAGE_DEADLINE_MS.
